files.b0-monthly-sc-v1.yaml:
# B0: a MEASUREMENT shadow (story R3, owner decision 1 A, 16 Oct 2026). Never promoted: approving it to paper needs the
# owner's own decision, which this label does not grant. Experiment 1's policy P1 exactly (response 92's B0 row). P1
# lost Rs 34,486 over 60 opportunities in 2019-23 (Rs 23,140 without 7 impossible stale-close exits;
# research/2026-10-12-experiment-1/RESULTS.md). It measures premium, costs and the fill path at real quotes and can
# never show an edge. Idea card: research/ideas/B0.md.
name: b0-monthly-sc
version: 1
status: research
payer: >-
  Measurement only, no claimed payer: option buyers may overpay for NIFTY index protection (variance risk premium,
  implied above realised by a median 2 points), but experiment 1 found no edge after costs. B0 records the real
  premium, costs and fills at 15:00 quotes.
edge_family: measurement
structure:
  code: SC
  strikes_rule: sell the call nearest spot x 1.02 and the put nearest spot x 0.98 (entry day's chain), buy each W further out
  width_rule: largest W of 300, 250, 200, 150, 100 points whose modelled maximum loss incl. charges and pads is at most Rs 10,000
  widths: [300, 250, 200, 150, 100]
  lots: 1
  expiry:
    kind: monthly
    min_days: 30
    max_days: 45
    exit_days_before_expiry: 21
entry_conditions: []
live_use_rule:
  min_days: 20
  min_agreement: 0.9
  min_available: 0.9
size_rule: 1 lot (65 units); no trade if the modelled maximum loss incl. charges exceeds Rs 10,000
funding:
  margin_per_lot: 67595
  # NSE's initial margin, not C2's stressed margin (about 98,013 at k 1.45) or the funds at entry (about Rs 1,00,784)
  source: NSE SPAN plus exposure for SC 300, 14 Oct 2026 (research/data/margins/margins.csv; response 92)
  date: 2026-10-14
exits:
  time: the last trading day with 21 or more calendar days to expiry, at 15:00
  profit: none  # held to the time exit
  loss: none  # nothing beyond the bought wings: the maximum loss is capped at entry
  event: none
evaluation_plan:
  expected_range:  # P1's 10th-90th percentile single-trade net, 58 traded cycles 2019-23 (results_challenge.json);
  # a range of single trades, while E6's review compares the mean with its low: restate it before B0 reaches 20 positions
    low: -5084
    high: 4156
  expected_net_per_opportunity: -386
  expected_net_source: experiment 1 challenge 2019-2023, P1, -Rs 23,140 over 60 opportunities without 7 impossible stale-close exits (-Rs 34,486 with them); worst clean trade -8,937
  unit: Rs C1 net per opportunity after charges and pads, before tax
  review_dates:
    - 2027-01-15
    - 2027-04-15
  pause_rules:
    - a single trade loses Rs 10,000 or more including charges (E6 alerts; a research version is never paused, the owner decides)
    - realised net at or below -Rs 30,000 (3 x cap; E6 alerts; expected for a measurement, not a defect)
  catastrophic_loss_rs: 10000
evidence:
  test_results_path: null
  test_results_commit: null
  red_team_note: null
  judge_verdict: null
  freeze_record: null
  owner_approval_date: null
files.example-sc-iv-rich-no-event-v1.yaml:
# WORKED EXAMPLE of the playbook format (story D1). NOT A PASSED STRATEGY and never to be approved as it stands.
# Its rule is experiment 1's policy P6 ("SC if F1 > 0 and no event"), which FAILED the 2019-2023 challenge:
# -Rs 18,468 over 60 opportunities (research/2026-10-12-experiment-1/RESULTS.md). The funding and expected-range
# numbers below are illustrative, not measured. Status stays `research`; the evidence stays empty.
name: example-sc-iv-rich-no-event
version: 1
status: research
payer: >-
  Hypothesis only: option buyers who overpay for NIFTY index protection when implied volatility is above realised
  volatility (the variance risk premium). Experiment 1 found no such edge after costs in 2019-2023.
edge_family: short premium, defined risk
structure:
  code: SC
  strikes_rule: sell the call nearest spot x 1.02 and the put nearest spot x 0.98 (entry day's chain), buy each W further out
  width_rule: largest W of 300, 250, 200, 150, 100 points whose modelled maximum loss incl. charges and pads is at most Rs 10,000
  widths: [300, 250, 200, 150, 100]
  lots: 1
  expiry:
    kind: monthly
    min_days: 30
    max_days: 45
    exit_days_before_expiry: 21
entry_conditions:
  - feature: F1_atm_iv_minus_rv20
    operator: ">"
    threshold: 0
  - feature: F3_scheduled_event_in_window
    operator: is
    threshold: false
live_use_rule:
  min_days: 20
  min_agreement: 0.9
  min_available: 0.9
size_rule: 1 lot (65 units); no trade if the modelled maximum loss incl. charges exceeds Rs 10,000
funding:
  margin_per_lot: 20000
  source: ILLUSTRATIVE, not measured (research/data/margins/margins.csv has no SC row yet)
  date: 2026-10-14
exits:
  time: the last trading day with 21 or more calendar days to expiry, at 15:00
  profit: none  # held to the time exit
  loss: none  # nothing beyond the bought wings: the maximum loss is capped at entry
  event: none
evaluation_plan:
  expected_range:
    low: -1500
    high: 500
  expected_net_per_opportunity: -308
  expected_net_source: experiment 1 challenge 2019-2023, P6, -Rs 18,468 over 60 opportunities (a FAIL)
  unit: Rs net per opportunity after charges, pads and 31.2% tax (illustrative)
  review_dates:
    - 2027-01-14
    - 2027-04-14
  pause_rules:
    - a single trade loses more than Rs 10,000 including charges (catastrophic-loss rule)
    - the book's drawdown brake (Rs 30,000 below its highest closed equity)
  catastrophic_loss_rs: 10000
evidence:
  test_results_path: null
  test_results_commit: null
  red_team_note: null
  judge_verdict: null
  freeze_record: null
  owner_approval_date: null
